title: A Uniform Square-Root Edge-Deficit Bound for Strongly Critical Graphs Avoiding Four- and Eight-Cycles
decided_scope: Every nonempty finite simple graph G of minimum degree >= 3 with no proper subgraph of minimum degree >= 3 and no simple C_4 or C_8 satisfies n <= max(8d, 4d^2-8d) <= 4d^2 where d = 2n - m
open_boundaries: Unrestricted Erdos-Gyarfas power-of-two cycle conjecture for all minimum-degree-three graphs
